# FG-CI-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 504 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_job_past_its_timeout_kills_and_removes_its_container` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブが時間切れで止められました。
- en: The CI job was stopped because it ran out of time.
- id: Tugas CI dihentikan karena waktunya habis.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C4: the job ran longer than its `timeout` in `.forge-ci.yml`. `forge-runner` killed its container (`podman kill`, then `podman rm -f`), removed the work directory and reported the job as failed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (info) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id` and `timeout_s`; the job's log ends with the same code.

## 対処 (fix)

Make the job faster or raise its `timeout` (at most 4 hours) in `.forge-ci.yml`, then push.
